content: Goday Aadho Erateth Immana Mala Solomoone Woosa
Solomooney Gibxe kawo Paaroonera laggetidi iza nayo machcho ekkides; kawo keeththaa, GODAA Keeththaanne Yerusalaame yuushon diza dirsaa gimbi polanaashe gakkanaas izo ehidi Dawite kataman woththides.
GODAA sunththas Xoossa Keeth keexettanaashe gakkanaas asay yarsho zumbullata bolla shiishshees.
Solomooney GODAA siiqees; ba aawa Dawite wogaa mala dees; gido attiin zumbullata bolla yarsho yarsheessinne exaane cuwasees.
Geba7ooney ubbaafe aadhdhi erettida yarshosoho gidida gishshas kawo Solomooney yarsho yarshanaas hee bides; Solomooney 1,000 mehe ehidi heen xuugettiza yarsho yarshides.
GODAY Solomoones Geba7oonen omars agumon qonccides; Xoossi izas, «Ta nees immana mala ne koyza ay miishshika tana oychcha» gides.

Solomooney izas, «Ta aawa Dawiti ne sinththan xilloteththan, tumateththaninne suureteththa wozinan simerettida gishshas ne aylleza gita kiyateth bessadasa; neni he gita kiyateththaa aggontta hach iza kawoteththa araatan uttiza attuma naa izas immadasa.
«Abeet GODAWU, ta Xoossawu! Neni tana ne aylleza, ta aawa Dawite sohon kawosadasa; gido attiin tani buro yelaga gidida gishshas asaa wostta ayssanaakko ta erikke.
Tani ne aylley neni doorida asaa giddoninne qooday baynda keehi daro asaa giddon de7ays.
Hessa gishshas tani ne asaa ayssanaas lo7onne iita shaakkada erana mala taas ne ayllezas akeekiza wozina imma; histtontta aggiko ha gita dereza ooni kaaleththana dandayzee?» gides.
Solomooney hessa oychchida gishshas GODAY ufayettides.
Qasseka Xoossay iza, «Neni nees layththi aduqqana mala woykko durettana mala, woykko ne morkketi hayqqana mala gidontta deraa wogara ayssanaas aadho erateth oychchida gishshas,
hessa ne oychchidayssa ta nees immana; neeppe kase oonaska imettonttanne neeppe guye oonikka demmontta aadho erateththaninne akeekay kumida wozina ta nees immana.
Hessafekka bollara ne de7o layththan ubbaan kawota giddon nenara ginattiza kawoy dontta mala neni tana oychchontta dureteththinne bonchcho ta nees immana.
Ne aawa Dawiti ta ogera bida mala nekka ta ogera biikko, ta wogaanne ta azazota naagikko ne layth ta adussana» gides.

Hessafe guye Solomooney dhiskofe beeggidi hessi agumo gididayssa akeekides; izi Yerusalaame simmi biidi GODAA Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa sinththan eqqides; xuugettiza yarshonne issifeteththa yarsho yarshides. Histtidi ba shuume ubbatas gibira kessides.
Solomooney Aadho Erateththan Pirdida Pirda
He wode layman aqiza nam7u maccassati kawo Solomoonekko yiidi iza sinththan eqqida.
Isttafe issiniya, «Ta godoo! Taninne ha maccassaya issi keeththan doos; heen iza tanara issife dishin tani naa yeladis.
Ta yelida heedzdzanththo gallas izakka naa yeladus; he keeththan nu nam7atappe attiin haray oonikka deenna.
«Issi gallassa omars hanna maccassaya ba naaza bolla ichchiin naazi hayqqides.
Histtiin iza giddoth dendada tani ne ashkariya dhiskon dishin ta naaza ta ki7oppe ekka efada ba ki7on woththadus; qasse hayqqida ba naaza ehada ta ki7on woththadus.
Wontiin tani ta naaza dhanththanaas dendishin hayqqi beettides; gido attiin tani maalado poo7on tishshi histta xeelliin ta yeloza gidonttayssa ta eradis» gadus.

Hankko nam7anththo maccassaya qasse, «Chii! Paxa diza naazi tayssa; hayqqida naazi neyssa» gadus. Gido attiin koyro maccassaya zaarada, «Chii! Hayqqida naazi neyssa; paxa diza naazi tayssa» gadus; istti nam7ayka kawoza sinththan hessaththo gishe palamettida.
Kawo Solomooney isttas, «Ha maccassaya, ‹Paxa diza naazi tayssa; hayqqida nay neyssa› gawus; hankkoorakka, ‹Chii! Hayqqidayssi ne naaza; paxa diza naazi ta naaza› gawus» gides.
Kawozikka, «Taas giththa mashsha ekki yiite» gides; histtiin istti izas giththa mashsha ehida.
He wode kawozi, «Paxa diza naaza nam7u kessi phalqidi issi baggaa issineys, issi baggaa hankkoors immite» gi azazides.

Paxa diza naaza aaya ba naazas keeha mishettiza gishshas kawozas, «Ta godoo! Paxa diza naaza izis immaaga! Wodhopparkkii!» gadus. Gido attiin hankkoora, «Neeskka taaska imettofo; nam7u kezi shaaketto» gadus.
Hessafe guye kawozi, «Ha paxa diza naaza ha koyro maccassays immite; naaza wodhopite; naaza aaya hannoko!» giidi pirdides.
Asaas xilloteththan pirdanaas izas aadho erateththay Xoossafe imettidayssa be7ida gishshas Isra7eele asay ubbay kawoy pirdida pirdaa siyida wode kawozas keehippe yayyides.
